what: One live run of the optional hold in the reference app's order, with the itemator job injected by the pipeline execution policy (merge request 85 on a throwaway target branch whose policy file has hold_until_named = true; 'Pipelines must succeed' on). Written as it happened; no cases file because it repeats the first hold run (merge request 45) with the job now coming from the policy.
limits: One run. The merge went into a throwaway target branch. My script first missed the card's start note, assigned the card account as reviewer, and so started a second card run that posted the same card again (a few credits wasted); the card had in fact started by itself about a minute after the failed pipeline.
